title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting in machine learning models. It adds a penalty to the loss function to discourage complex models.

title: Training vs. Validation Error
text: If both training and validation errors are decreasing, it indicates that the model is learning well and generalizing to unseen data.

title: When to Adjust Regularization
text: Regularization should be adjusted if the model is overfitting or underfitting. Overfitting occurs when the training error is low, but the validation error is high.
